name: Materials Chemistry
summary: Chemical routes to ceramics, glasses, thin films, alloys, composites and smart materials, and how chemistry sets their properties.

topics.name: Structure-processing-property relationships from a chemist's perspective
Ceramics: oxides, nitrides and carbides; powder processing and sintering
Sol-gel chemistry and hybrid organic-inorganic materials
Thin-film deposition chemistry: CVD, ALD and PVD
Metals and alloys: alloying chemistry and intermetallics
Smart materials: shape-memory, self-healing and stimuli-responsive
Critical raw materials and materials sustainability
